It does not mutate balances. This is an all-time/current balance calculation, independent of selected report dates.

items.coordinator_source_reasoning: Queries waste/spoilage/breakage movements over UTC [start,end), takes nullable LossValue values, sums null as zero and preserves total row count. It composes offers/comps/discounts/refunds and selected-period expenses from already computed report inputs; it writes no stock or accounting rows.
items.counterevidence_and_limits: A null-valued loss contributes zero to money total while still increasing count. Whether this is acceptable depends on loss valuation policy and DTO meaning; source does not establish that unknown means zero or show a realized row. No specific null-loss test found in reviewed test paths.
items.exact_remaining_action: Specify whether unknown cost should yield an incomplete/unknown total; test null vs zero, count semantics, and UTC boundary. Do not claim live underreport absent data/policy evidence.
items.agent_reasoning: GetAsync supplies selected-range sales, expense total, refund count, and UTC start/end (lines 46-59). LoadLeakage queries Waste/Spoilage/Breakage StockMovements by CreatedAtUtc in [start,end), projects nullable LossValuePiastres, sums null as zero but returns losses.Count separately; it composes SalesReport values for offers/comps/manual discounts/refunds plus the passed expenses (lines 175-183). This is read-only report composition; it does not write accounting or inventory rows.
items.agent_counterevidence: Receipt reasoning accurately flags a meaningful completeness caveat: a row with null loss value contributes zero to money total while remaining visible in count. This could understate reported leakage if such rows are legitimate financial loss with unknown valuation. The source distinguishes count from priced loss but gives no dashboard DTO field for unknown-valued loss count; verify whether `LossesCount` denotes all loss rows or valued rows before treating the total as complete. No specific existing test asserting null loss handling was found in this batch; no evidence of a mutation error.

items.coordinator_source_reasoning: Filters employee-ledger credits for six earning categories by CreatedAtUtc in [start,end), sums credits and count; advances/withdrawals/deductions are excluded. GetAsync feeds total and count to BuildProfitability. Domain profitability keeps wage ratio null only when no wage rows were posted, otherwise uses the supplied gross credit total.
items.counterevidence_and_limits: This avoids double counting advances/withdrawals as fresh labor cost, but policy does not define whether the dashboard should use gross earned credits, net payroll payouts, or another period expense basis. Ledger read and dashboard reads lack a shared snapshot; no actual discrepancy shown.
items.exact_remaining_action: Owner should confirm accounting presentation basis. Test each included/excluded ledger category, boundary timestamps, zero postings vs zero-sum posted rows, and provider snapshot consistency if point-in-time report consistency is required.
items.agent_reasoning: GetAsync passes period UTC boundaries to LoadWagesPostedAsync and uses its total in BuildProfitability (lines 58-59, 205-224). The helper filters EmployeeLedgerEntries to DailyWage, Salary, Overtime, ExtraShift, Bonus, OtherEarning by CreatedAtUtc >= start and < end; materializes CreditPiastres and returns sum and row count (lines 193-202). Advances/withdrawals/deductions are not netted here. It is a read-only ledger aggregation.
items.agent_counterevidence: The existing receipt correctly distinguishes earnings credits from advances/withdrawals, which would otherwise double-count already-earned wages, and notes gross-vs-net expense semantics need a business decision. Category list includes six positive earning types; no calculation of payroll liability settlement is made here. No focused OwnerDashboard integration assertion was located by static search; source confirms only aggregate path. No writer correlation/live dataset check.
